landing.pilaresSubtitulo: Built for owners and property managers who demand total operational control.
landing.pilar1Desc: The platform only charges a fixed monthly fee per active Unit. We never take cuts from your contracts.
landing.pilar2Desc: Accurate geolocation via Leaflet and Nominatim, with public approximate radius and exact pin after login.
landing.pilar3Desc: Rental history, tenant CRM, deposits, availability calendar and high-density operational metrics.
landing.pilar4Desc: Full experience in Spanish, English and Portuguese to attract both national and international guests to Goya.

landing.paso3Desc: Seekers contact your phone directly without intermediaries or delays.

bento.commissionDesc: 100% of what you charge is yours. Rendo does not charge commission on your rentals or hold deposits. You only pay an affordable fixed monthly quota per published unit.
bento.whatsappDesc: One-on-one communication between manager and tenant. No intermediaries, no delays, and freedom to agree on payment terms directly.
bento.osmDesc: Approximate location for casual visitors and exact geolocation protected for registered users, safeguarding your property.
bento.osmSession: Exact pin protected by user session
bento.terminalDesc: Availability, tenant, contract, and deposit control in one unified place designed to simplify your daily work.

testimonials.title: Trusted by Local Property Managers
testimonials.subtitle: What Property Managers operating their portfolio on Rendo say.
testimonials.item1Quote: Being able to manage 8 cabins along Goya's waterfront without platform commission deductions transformed my profitability.
testimonials.item2Quote: The approximate radius map protects unit privacy for anonymous visitors, and serious seekers reach out via WhatsApp.
testimonials.item3Quote: The financial terminal and incremental quota calculation make scaling from 5 to 15 units transparent and accessible.
